canonical_incident_record.title: UPS Haslet robotic system not responding; AGVs out of sync and small sort stopped
canonical_incident_record.incident_description: High-priority production incident at the UPS Fort Worth/Haslet site where the robotic system stopped responding and site operations reported that nothing was moving. Evidence shows OptiSweep service termination at about 6:36 AM, concurrent WCSWebApplication/application errors, AGVs going out of sync, and abnormal RMS/HMI behavior. Troubleshooting included Event Viewer review, Ignition gateway restart activity, service-state checks, API validation checks, and RMS review of AGV state. Case comments indicate the OptiSweep service was reset, out-of-sync AGVs were corrected in RMS, and the site resumed auto bag-out before later being reported as running.
canonical_incident_record.customer_operational_impact: Production was seriously impacted. The small sort was not running, bots were not moving in various areas, totes could not be removed from hospital, and the site shifted to manual bag-out during part of the incident.
canonical_incident_record.what_resolved_it: Source-supported recovery actions indicate the OptiSweep service was reset, RMS was used to locate and correct out-of-sync AGVs, and the site resumed auto bag-out. Later review evidence states the site was running at case close. Memory/log-size follow-up for the faulted web application was noted but not confirmed as the definitive incident fix.
